reuse.why: Keeps calling the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend for moved weekends, but the new skip rule is not added to that shared weekend helper; each path re-derives it.

duplication.why: The `skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily'` decision and the weekend filter are written three times: in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and createScheduleList.

placement.why: The rule belongs with getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts, yet server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts each embed their own version of it.

scope.why: Edits are on weekend handling only; threading frequency through parseRecurDate is needed plumbing.

maintainability.why: Three differently-shaped implementations (find over 7 occurrences, a loop with a 400-day guard, local closures) of one rule will drift when the rule changes again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList decide daily weekend skipping locally instead of through a shared definition next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend/getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily-skip rule is reshaped per site: `.find(!isWeekend)` over 7 occurrences in getNextDate, a for-loop with a guard in getUpcomingDates, and isSkippedDay/moveWeekend closures in createScheduleList.

one_place.where: The rule is decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList.
